name: Dolly-In Focus & Tension Build
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Frame a smooth `slow physical dolly push-in toward the subject's eyes, shallow 50mm depth of field, background gradually blurring and shifting in subtle parallax`, escalating emotional gravity smoothly.

name: Dolly-Out Environmental Scale Reveal
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Execute `steady dolly pull-back moving away from the solitary subject`, widening from tight framing to expose towering cliffs, ruins, or neon traffic stretching outward.

name: Fixed-Radius Clockwise Hero Orbit
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Instruct `smooth continuous clockwise orbit around the centered subject at fixed radius, background walls and bokeh lamps rotating cleanly behind a poised figure`.

name: Counter-Clockwise Tension Arc
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Sweep `unhurried counter-clockwise 90-degree orbital arc` transitioning from profile to tense front-quarter confrontation while lighting shifts smoothly from silhouette rim to key face.

name: Hitchcock Vertigo Dolly-Zoom (Zolly)
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Prompt `Vertigo dolly-zoom effect: camera tracks physically backward while optical lens zooms steadily inward, keeping subject torso same size as corridor walls stretch dramatically behind`.

name: Lateral Truck Parallel Track
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Move camera smoothly `parallel laterally beside the moving subject at waist height`, foreground columns whipping quickly across lens while mid-ground subject stays locked sharp.

name: High-Speed Whip Pan Snap Cut
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Hold initial beat briefly. Then execute `fast blurred horizontal whip pan right sweeping across light streaks, snapping dead-sharp onto the waiting opponent`.

name: Vertical Pedestal / Jib Rise
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Elevate lens smoothly vertically from street level (`smooth vertical crane/pedestal rise sweeping upward past glowing awnings`) revealing wet rooftops and horizon skyline.

name: Steadicam Floating Corridor Trail
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `fluid low-vibration Steadicam follow tracking two paces behind character shoulders through heavy swinging doors into illuminated hall`, preserving smooth fluid glide.

name: FPV Racing Drone Gap Dive
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Instruct `dynamic banked FPV drone glide swooping through steel archway and diving cleanly along sunlit misty waterfall gorge, smooth wide-angle motion`.

name: Locked Tripod Observational Tableau
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify `locked-off stationary tripod wide shot` so every brick and beam holds razor still while natural life—steam vents, passing cyclist, swaying lantern—flows calmly through frame.

name: Punchy Action Crash-Zoom In
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Hold wide standoff briefly. Then apply `sudden fast optical crash-zoom tightly onto narrowing eyes or weapon trigger`, spiking rhythmic pacing instantly.

name: Crane Lift Over Foreground Barrier
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Begin tight behind dark silhouetted parapet/boulders and smoothly boom upward + forward (`rising cinema crane reveal`), unveiling a luminous sunrise harbor or camp beyond.

name: Snorricam Chest-Locked Panic Run
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor `chest-mounted Snorricam locked onto breathless runner's face centered tight in 24mm frame` while blurred neon streetlamps and wet brickwork whip violently behind.

name: Mirror Reflection Slide Reveal
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Start tight inside cracked mirror or wing-mirror reflection, then slide camera smoothly outward revealing the rain-swept avenue and real subject together in spatial clarity.

name: Low Asphalt Pursuit Vehicle Rig
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Position `low pursuit camera rig hovering inches over streaking wet tarmac`, pacing smoothly beside spinning dark alloy wheels and glowing amber brake rotors.

name: Over-Shoulder Standoff Drift
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Frame past soft foreground shoulder on left (`shallow 85mm over-the-shoulder shot`) slowly pushing right to isolate opposing character's tense expression on beat two.

name: Overhead Spiral & Trail Tracking
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Glide `90-degree bird's-eye top-down camera tracking smoothly over rain-slick crosswalk umbrellas` rotating slightly to match geometric movement paths below.

name: Majestic Slow Horizon Pan
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Instruct `unhurried tripod fluid-head pan left-to-right across sunlit glacial lake and pine ridge`, letting mist curl naturally along distant peaks.

name: Intimate Handheld Documentary Breath
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `subtle organic handheld 35mm cinema cadence` with minor shoulder micro-sway that tracks tiny eye-line adjustments and finger fidgeting honestly.

name: Seamless Glass Threshold Glide
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Move `smooth camera glide tracking through open timber cafe window` transitioning effortlessly from rainy cobblestone dusk outside to warm tungsten interior light.

name: Architectural Pillar Wipe Reveal
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Track laterally past a close dark stone/steel column wiping cleanly across lens (`natural occlusion wipe`), revealing protagonist striding down platform right as frame clears.

name: Slow Unsettling Horizon Roll
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Execute `gradual 20-degree axial camera roll across silent mist-filled hall`, inducing weightless architectural vertigo without losing crisp floor edges.

name: Leading Track Backward Ahead of Walker
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Glide `smoothly backward at chest height leading directly ahead of the striding protagonist`, keeping determined eyes locked sharp while neon corridor doors recede smoothly behind.

name: Ground-to-Sky Vertical Tilt Up
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Start tight on mud-spattered boots or snow crust, then execute `steady smooth upward vertical tilt` sweeping over wool coat folds and steel sword hilt up toward golden clouds.
